name: rea
purpose: Reverse engineer native binaries, Electron/JavaScript apps, Android packages, .NET assemblies, firmware, network captures, and crashes using the REA framework with verifiable evidence.
baseline_failure: Without this skill, agents get lost across 138 granular MCP tools, call disassemblers on JavaScript or ASAR targets, dump massive raw hex streams that consume context windows, fail to use summary-first Evidence graphs, fail when external engines (Hopper/Ghidra) are absent instead of using native layout/diagnostics or CLI fallbacks, and speculate without cited evidence.

positive: reverse engineer this binary or application
understand how this feature works in the binary, show evidence, and reconstruct it
analyze this Electron ASAR or JavaScript bundle
decompile function at address or symbol
inspect network capture HAR or APK package with rea
negative: review this git pull request diff for code quality
run playwright browser smoke tests on my web app
fix typescript compilation error in src/index.ts

outputs: Target Classification and Selected Analysis Pathway
Evidence-backed analysis report with confirmed symbols, offsets, and decompiled pseudocode
Reconstructed high-level implementation verified against observed behavior
invariants: Never hallucinate binary behavior; every architectural claim must cite concrete REA Evidence, offsets, or decompiled symbols
Summary-first: inspect overviews, symbols, and call graphs before requesting full decompilation or raw byte ranges
Static JavaScript/Electron analysis must never demand Hopper or Ghidra engines
CLI commands must prefer Bun execution (bunx rea-agents or local rea binary)

workflow.action: Classify target type and determine analysis pathway (Native, Electron/JS, Android, .NET, Firmware, Web/HAR)
workflow.why: Prevents invalid tool selection such as invoking native disassemblers on web bundles

workflow.action: Bind session or run target-free analysis using open_binary, analyze_javascript_application, or CLI
workflow.why: Establishes a valid analysis session and verifies tool availability before probing

workflow.action: Perform summary-first exploration using binary_overview, search_strings, search_procedures, or application graph
workflow.why: Prevents context exhaustion by locating candidate seeds before decompiling

workflow.action: Trace candidate functions, xrefs, data flow, and extract pseudocode or boundary evidence
workflow.why: Gathers definitive proof of how the feature operates under the hood

workflow.action: Synthesize clean implementation and construct evidence ledger verifying the reconstructed logic
workflow.why: Ensures the delivered code is authentic to the observed artifact with zero hallucinations
